Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.animation

Enum Class Property

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Property>
io.jengacode.eduvideo.animation.Property
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Property>, Constable
public enum Property extends Enum<Property>
Properties use doubles; COLOR holds an ARGB integer represented exactly as a double.

Defines the XML name and initial value for each numeric property. Objects explicitly declare which properties they support; timeline tracks override initial values.
